confidence_notes: I based the restaurant, coffee and beer anchors on one web search of cost-of-living aggregators: Numbeo, Wise, CityCost, nomad.watch and Stamped Nomad. They give an inexpensive meal at about USD 3 to 3.50, a cappuccino at about USD 2 to 3, a mid-range dinner for two at about USD 25 to 41, and local beer at about USD 1.20 to 3. Their figures differ a lot. Numbeo says its Koh Lanta data is sparse and partly estimated, and some figures are from 2023 to 2025. I nudged the anchors toward tourist-area prices. July 2026 is low season (monsoon), which may push prices down a little. I did not search directly for cocktail or wine prices. I estimated them from local price ratios to beer: cocktails are usually 3 to 4 times the price of a beer, and imported wine is expensive in Thailand because of high import taxes. Accommodation figures are general model estimates for low season and are the least certain. I did not check any booking sites or listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Koh Lanta with other Andaman-coast tourist islands and beach towns in Thailand, such as Ao Nang in Krabi and quieter parts of Phuket. Food is a bit cheaper than in Phuket's main tourist areas, and drink prices follow the usual Thai pattern.
